problem: Turn the validated P1-P5 movement, pollination, progression, restoration and seed-ownership systems into one coherent six-Meadow Sunny Meadows region that completes from a clean save on HTML5, proves Flight/Buzz 3 and the Lily gate, preserves state through save v4, exposes accessibility/audio settings and analytics through platform-neutral seams, and passes current Poki-oriented viewport/request/performance budgets without regressing P1-P5.

decision.rationale: P6 validates D-011 as one continuous authored region rather than one collection proxy per Meadow. Exact-head deterministic tests and Chromium evidence complete all six authored Meadows from a clean save, exercise Flight/Buzz 3 and Lily's Buzz-3 gate, use seed ownership, persist settings/region state through save v4, emit the platform-neutral analytics schema, fill desktop/mobile/Poki viewports, make zero external requests, and stay within FPS/bundle budgets. The independent visual evaluation records PASS WITH DEVIATION because the runtime illustration remains intentionally geometric and below the long-term rounded/species-silhouette art-direction target even though no external placeholder assets or critical functional placeholders remain.
